verdict.rationale: Perplexity Sonar is explicitly an API product with extensive public documentation, an OpenAPI spec, official SDKs (with sync/async clients, streaming, retries, typed errors), a CLI, and MCP server integration for agentic workflows—clearly enabling AI-native users to drive the product programmatically. missing for 10: independent third-party benchmarking of API reliability/coverage beyond vendor docs and SDK repo.
